translation: U-um, I was hearing from Kyon earlier.

About whether or not Nagato resembles a
cat…

He said that you had brought it up when you
went to the computer society.

Ah, that. Yes yes, Yuki has sort of a cat-like
quality to her, doesn't she?

You get that sort of impression just by
looking at her, don't you think?

Yes… I suppose they feel similar to each
other.
Yuki is like a kitty cat?
Do you get that same feeling, little sister?
Hmm, I probably don't know…
Then try to picture this…

Yuki wearing a pair of cute cat ears, a collar
with a bell on it, and a long tail to top it all off.
Don't you think that would suit her?
Yep, it would really suit her!

Though personally, I imagine her as a pure
white cat.

Surprisingly though, a black cat doesn't feel
wrong either. Which camp are you in, Mikuru?
Huh? M-me?

Don't black cats have sort of a mischievous
energy to them?

That feels a bit different from Yuki… And yet,
it still seems like it fits somehow.
I-I think either way suits her.

You're right, it's hard to rule out either black
or white. Let's set this problem aside for now.
If Yuki is a cat, then what animal is Mikuru?
Mikuru? Hmm…

Mikuru has to be a bunny. I can't imagine
anything else!
I-I'm a bunny?

The bunny suit was such a perfect match for
you—just as I'd anticipated!

Oh yeah, next time I definitely have to get
Yuki to wear a cat ear headband.

They're also selling tight-fitting one-piece
catsuits, so…

If we could get cat cosplay Yuki, and bunny
girl Mikuru together…
It would be a moe overload!
What about you, Haru-nyan?
Me? Hm… Right.

I have a bunny suit of my own, but I can't just
be the same as Mikuru.

In that case, I've gotta be a wolf, huh? I
wonder if they sell wolf suits?

But it all depends on if Nagato will dress up as
a cat for you in the first place…
She will.

I mean, Yuki seems like the type who'd just nod
quietly and do it.
I-I guess that's true. I get the same feeling.

Yuki wearing a cat outfit is such a good idea.
We've seriously got to try it out sometime!
[#P06]…Sorry, Nagato.
Did you say something?
N-no, nothing.
I wonder what Kyon would be?
Kyon? Isn't it obvious?
A sloth. There's simply no other option.
A-ahaha…

I somehow diverted us into a weird tangent,
but it looks like it bought us some time.
I'm rooting for you Kyon. Please do your best.
